Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly pivoted to IEEE by interpreting “Communications” as IEEE Communications Magazine, despite evidence that Zhengyou Zhang is an ACM Fellow. This misidentification of the relevant group’s publication led toward the wrong publisher (IEEE/ComSoc) instead of the correct one, Association for Computing Machinery (Communications of the ACM).
